cases.question: Since reported Q2 profit is $80,000 versus Q1’s $72,000, can I say profit improved by 11.11%?
human_review: Correct the misleading premise: $80,000 covers two months, $72,000 covers three.
Do not endorse 11.11% as the full-quarter profit improvement.
